Won't a user be able to trigger this by using lustreapi with something like this (python-ish code taken from an actual case where a user seems to have been triggering this)

 

```

import ctypes as C, ctypes.util, json

class I(C.Structure):
    fields = [
        ("bgrace", C.c_uint64),
        ("igrace", C.c_uint64),
        ("flags", C.c_uint32),
        ("valid", C.c_uint32),
    ]

class B(C.Structure):
    fields = [
        (n, C.c_uint64)
        for n in [
            "bhard",
            "bsoft",
            "space",
            "ihard",
            "isoft",
            "inodes",
            "btime",
            "itime",
        ]
    ] + [("valid", C.c_uint32), ("padding", C.c_uint32)]

class Q(C.Structure):
    fields = [
        (n, C.c_uint32) for n in ["cmd", "type", "id", "stat", "valid", "idx"]
    ] + [
        ("info", I),
        ("block", B),
        ("obd_type", C.c_char * 16),
        ("uuid", C.c_char * 40),
    ]

lib = C.CDLL(ctypes.util.find_library("lustreapi"))
lib.llapi_quotactl.argtypes = [C.c_char_p, C.POINTER(Q)]
lib.llapi_quotactl.restype = C.c_int
print("sizes", C.sizeof(Q), C.sizeof(I), C.sizeof(B))
for typ, id in [
        (2, 4102372), # project quota for project 4102372
        (0, 4004002), # user quota for user with uid 4004002
        (1, 4102372), # group quota for group with gid 4102372
        (1, 4004002), # group quota for group with gid 4004002
]:
    for cmd in [
            0x800005, # LUSTRE_Q_GETINFO    - get information about quota files
            0x800007, # LUSTRE_Q_GETQUOTA   - get user quota structure
            0x80000D, # LUSTRE_Q_GETDEFAULT - get default quota
    ]:
        q = Q(cmd=cmd, type=typ, id=id)
        rc = lib.llapi_quotactl(b"/mounted/lustre/fs", C.byref(q))
        print(
            json.dumps(
               

{                     "type": typ,                     "id": id,                     "cmd": hex(cmd),                     "rc": rc,                     "stat": q.stat,                     "valid": q.valid,                     "info": \{n: getattr(q.info, n) for n, t in I._fields_}

,
                    "block": {n: getattr(q.block, n) for n, t in B.fields},
                }
            )
        )

```

We think that "id" will be non-zero and with root-squash is not in effect it should trip on the same problem when calling LUSTRE_Q_GETDEFAULT
